title: Structure makes quantum circuits trainable
abstract: arXiv:2611.18378v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The scalability of variational quantum algorithms is limited by barren plateaus, where gradients vanish exponentially in system size. This worst-case result raises fundamental questions about the trainability of quantum AI models. We present a major advance towards resolving this trainability question by answering whether a given quantum circuit has a barren plateau. We do this using an analytical framework that bounds the gradient variance for arbitrary input states $\rho$ and observables $\mathcal{M}$ by decomposing the unitary representation of the associated compact Lie group. When the circuit segments on both sides of a gate form $2$-designs, we obtain the variance exactly and prove a sufficient condition for trainability: if $\rho^{\otimes 2}$ and $\mathcal{M}^{\otimes 2}$ are sufficiently concentrated on the same irreducible invariant subspace of polynomial dimension, and the differentiated gate moves this subspace by an inverse

translated_title: 结构使量子电路可训练
translated_abstract: 变分量子算法的可扩展性受到贫瘠高原的限制——在贫瘠高原中，梯度随系统规模呈指数级消失。这一最坏情况的结果对量子AI模型的可训练性提出了根本性问题。我们通过回答“一个给定的量子电路是否具有贫瘠高原”这一问题，在解决可训练性难题上取得了重大进展。我们的方法是采用一个分析框架：通过分解相关紧致李群的幺正表示，为任意输入态 ρ 和可观测量 ℳ 的梯度方差给出界定。当被求导门两侧的电路段形成 2-设计时，我们精确求得了梯度方差，并证明了可训练性的一个充分条件：若 ρ^{⊗2} 与 ℳ^{⊗2} 充分集中于同一个多项式维数的不可约不变子空间，且被求导的门以逆……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个通过分解紧致李群幺正表示来界定任意输入态和可观测量下梯度方差的分析框架，据此给出判定量子电路是否具有贫瘠高原的方法，并证明了量子电路可训练性的充分条件。
